notes.subject: gate and city
notes.rationale: Imperatives summon the gate and the city to wail — a funeral-lament opening.

notes.subject: to Philistia
notes.rationale: Pelesheth is again addressed directly, 'all of you'.

notes.subject: במועדיו
notes.rationale: 'in his appointed times/assemblies' — 'no straggler in his ranks' (ASV/JPS) vs 'none alone at his appointed time' (Geneva); rendered as ranks staying together.

notes.subject: siisi
notes.rationale: Smoke stands for an advancing army — the Hebrew image kept literally, the military referent left implicit as in the source.

translation: Wuluwo, da; kundenw tagali, dugu; Peleshetɔw, i bɛɛ, i bɛn tu na, sabu siisi bɛ bɔ kɔgɔnɔfɛ, a ka jɛkulu kɔnɔ mɔgɔ si tɛ kɛ kelen-yɛrɛ ye.
